name: lean4-lsp-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Lean 4 theorem proving, zero-latency .ilean navigation, and C FFI cross-language inspection

scripts.test: node --test tests/test_rules_fixtures.mjs && node --test tests/test_harvest.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_lean_lsp_mcp.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_file_worker_manager.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_counterexample_verb.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_project_root.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_diagnostics_ready.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_decl_references.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_abstract_interpreter.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_tranche1_modules.mjs && node tests/test_wasm_integration.mjs

author: r-irbe

tools.name: lean_goal
tools.description: Interactive proof state, filtered goal, term goal, and AltProof route/tactic advisor

tools.name: lean_search

tools.name: lean_blueprint
tools.description: Blueprint generation, status audit, zettels, skeletons, and knowledge graph neighborhood

tools.name: lean_metrics
tools.description: Module census, dependency hierarchy, DAG subgraphs, bigraphs, axiom audit, and AltProof analysis

tools.name: lean_ffi
tools.description: C FFI symbol resolution and Lean sysroot inspection

tools.name: lean_exec
tools.description: Ephemeral Lean 4 execution via lean --stdin

tools.name: lean_resync
tools.description: Force full document re-sync with LSP server

tools.name: lean_lookup_symbol
tools.description: Offline symbol lookup in compiled .ilean index

tools.description: Declaration-level uses/usedBy reference graph from .ilean index

tools.name: lean_module_hierarchy

tools.name: lean_diagnostics

tools.description: Cross-ITP concordance across Lean 4, Coq, Isabelle, and HOL Light
